segments.source: C# Tooling
segments.translation: C# 툴링

segments.source: WebAssembly components in C# can be built with [componentize-dotnet][componentize-dotnet], a NuGet package that can be used to create a fully ahead-of-time-compiled component, giving .NET developers a component experience comparable to those in Rust and TinyGo.
segments.translation: C#로 작성된 WebAssembly 컴포넌트는 NuGet 패키지인 [componentize-dotnet][componentize-dotnet]을 사용하여 빌드할 수 있으며, 이를 통해 완전히 AOT(ahead-of-time) 컴파일된 컴포넌트를 생성할 수 있어 .NET 개발자에게 Rust 및 TinyGo에 견줄 만한 컴포넌트 경험을 제공합니다.

segments.source: Building a Component with `componentize-dotnet`
segments.translation: `componentize-dotnet`으로 컴포넌트 빌드하기

segments.source: [`componentize-dotnet`][componentize-dotnet] serves as a one-stop shop, wrapping several tools into one:
segments.translation: [`componentize-dotnet`][componentize-dotnet]은 여러 도구를 하나로 감싼 원스톱 솔루션 역할을 합니다:

segments.source: [NativeAOT-LLVM](https://github.com/dotnet/runtimelab/tree/feature/NativeAOT-LLVM) (compilation)
segments.translation: [NativeAOT-LLVM](https://github.com/dotnet/runtimelab/tree/feature/NativeAOT-LLVM) (컴파일)

segments.source: [wit-bindgen](https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wit-bindgen) (WIT imports and exports)
segments.translation: [wit-bindgen](https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wit-bindgen) (WIT 임포트 및 익스포트)

segments.source: [wasm-tools](https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools) (component conversion)
segments.translation: [wasm-tools](https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools) (컴포넌트 변환)

segments.source: [WASI SDK](https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-sdk) (SDK used by NativeAOT-LLVM)
segments.translation: [WASI SDK](https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-sdk) (NativeAOT-LLVM에서 사용하는 SDK)

segments.source: [Wac](https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wac) (used to compose components)
segments.translation: [Wac](https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wac) (컴포넌트를 합성하는 데 사용)

segments.source: First, install the .NET SDK.
segments.translation: 먼저 .NET SDK를 설치하십시오.

segments.source: For this walkthrough, we’ll use the [.NET 10 SDK preview][dotnet-sdk].
segments.translation: 이 안내에서는 [.NET 10 SDK preview][dotnet-sdk]를 사용합니다.

segments.source: You should also have [wasmtime](https://wasmtime.dev/) installed so you can run the binary that you produce.
segments.translation: 생성한 바이너리를 실행할 수 있도록 [wasmtime](https://wasmtime.dev/)도 설치해야 합니다.

segments.source: You will also need to install [wac][wac] for composing components.
segments.translation: 또한 컴포넌트 합성을 위해 [wac][wac]도 설치해야 합니다.

segments.source: Building a component that imports an interface
segments.translation: 인터페이스를 임포트하는 컴포넌트 빌드하기

segments.source: So far, we've been dealing with library components.
segments.translation: 지금까지는 라이브러리 컴포넌트를 다루어 왔습니다.

segments.source: Now we will be creating a command component that implements the `hostapp` world.
segments.translation: 이제 `hostapp` 월드를 구현하는 커맨드 컴포넌트를 만들겠습니다.

segments.source: This component will import the `add` interface that is exported from our `adder` component and call the `add` function.
segments.translation: 이 컴포넌트는 `adder` 컴포넌트에서 익스포트된 `add` 인터페이스를 임포트하여 `add` 함수를 호출합니다.

segments.source: We will later compose this command component with the `adder` library component we just built.
segments.translation: 나중에 이 커맨드 컴포넌트를 방금 빌드한 `adder` 라이브러리 컴포넌트와 합성할 것입니다.

segments.source: Now we will be taking the `adder` component and executing it from another WebAssembly component.
segments.translation: 이제 `adder` 컴포넌트를 가져와 다른 WebAssembly 컴포넌트에서 실행해 보겠습니다.

segments.source: `dotnet new componentize.wasi.cli` creates a new project that creates an executable.
segments.translation: `dotnet new componentize.wasi.cli`는 실행 파일을 생성하는 새 프로젝트를 만듭니다.

segments.source: Change to the parent directory of your current project and create a new project:
segments.translation: 현재 프로젝트의 상위 디렉터리로 이동하여 새 프로젝트를 생성하십시오.

segments.source: Notice how the `World` changed from `example` to `hostapp`.
segments.translation: `World`가 `example`에서 `hostapp`으로 변경된 것에 주목하십시오.

segments.source: Once again, compile your component with `dotnet build`:
segments.translation: 다시 한번 `dotnet build`로 컴포넌트를 컴파일하십시오.

segments.source: At this point, you'll have two WebAssembly components:
segments.translation: 이 시점에서 두 개의 WebAssembly 컴포넌트가 생기게 됩니다.

segments.source: A component that implements the `example` world.
segments.translation: `example` 월드를 구현하는 컴포넌트

segments.source: A component that implements the `hostapp` world.
segments.translation: `hostapp` 월드를 구현하는 컴포넌트

segments.source: Since the `host-app` component depends on the `add` function which is defined in the `example` world, it needs to be composed with the first component.
segments.translation: `host-app` 컴포넌트는 `example` 월드에서 정의된 `add` 함수에 의존하므로, 첫 번째 컴포넌트와 합성되어야 합니다.

segments.translation: [`wac plug`](https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wac)를 실행하여 `host-app` 컴포넌트를 `adder` 컴포넌트와 합성할 수 있습니다.

segments.translation: 이를 위해서는 원본 `adder.wasm` 컴포넌트가 `host-app` 컴포넌트가 위치한 디렉터리를 기준으로 `../adder`에 있어야 합니다.

segments.source: If you run `dotnet build` again, you will have a composed component in `./dist/main.wasm`.
segments.translation: `dotnet build`를 다시 실행하면 `./dist/main.wasm`에 합성된 컴포넌트가 생성됩니다.

segments.translation: 더 많은 구성 옵션은 [componentize-dotnet 문서][componentize-dotnet-docs]를 참고하십시오.
